name: ice-stone
effect: Used on a party Pokémon : Evolves an Alola Sandshrew into Alola Sandslash or an Alola Vulpix into Alola Ninetales.
shortEffect: Evolves an Alola Sandshrew into Alola Sandslash or an Alola Vulpix into Alola Ninetales.

flavorTextEntries.text: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It has an unmistakable snowflake pattern.
